scripts.vers: npm pkg get name version --workspaces --include-workspace-root=false | jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.value.name, .value.version] | @tsv' | column -t
scripts.build:collaboration: npm run check:event-bindings && npm --workspace @birdnerd/events run build && npm --workspace @birdnerd/banding run build && npm --workspace @birdnerd/sync-state run build && npm --workspace @birdnerd/provisioner run build
scripts.test:collaboration: npm run build:collaboration && npm --workspace @birdnerd/events run test && npm --workspace @birdnerd/banding run test && npm --workspace @birdnerd/sync-state run test && npm --workspace @birdnerd/provisioner run test
scripts.provision: npm run build:collaboration && npm --workspace @birdnerd/provisioner run provision --
scripts.build:combined: npm run build && npm run build:ocr && rm -rf .combined-site && mkdir -p .combined-site/birdnerd/ocr && cp -R apps/field/dist/. .combined-site/birdnerd/ && cp -R apps/ocr/dist/. .combined-site/birdnerd/ocr/
scripts.test: npm run test:local-dev && npm run test:fixtures && npm run test:fixtures:invite && npm --workspace @birdnerd/field run test
